driver_of_the_day.label: +8.6 pts v expected
driver_of_the_day.why: Max Verstappen scored 15 from P6 on the grid; the model expected 6.4.

best_drive_from_back.label: P22 to P15
best_drive_from_back.why: Lance Stroll gained 7 places from P22 in the 11th-fastest car.

best_strategy.label: +5.4 places through the stops
best_strategy.why: Franco Colapinto's 2-stop race cost 5.4 fewer places in the pit windows than the race's average stop.

fastest_stop.label: 23.4 s in the pit lane
fastest_stop.why: Quickest trip through the pit lane, lap 2 (no stationary times published).

overtake_of_race.label: on Nico Hülkenberg, lap 8
overtake_of_race.why: Lance Stroll passed Nico Hülkenberg for P17 on lap 8 despite being +2.44 s/lap slower on corrected pace.

unluckiest.label: 25.0 points lost
unluckiest.why: Out on lap 30 with a retirement (cause not published) while running P1: 25 points gone.

smoothest.label: 0.565 s lap-time sd
smoothest.why: Max Verstappen's corrected clean laps varied by just 0.565 s (1 sd).

team_of_weekend.label: +12.1 pts v expected
team_of_weekend.why: Red Bull's drivers beat the model's expectation by 12.1 points combined.
